text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّى كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ

words.gloss_range: completed speech act introducing Joseph's direct petition under pressure
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, and framed utterance; here a decisive voiced petition, not neutral narration

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: personal vocative addressee of the prayer

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah as Joseph's spoken response, not as an inner thought or narrator summary. Its perfect speech frame gathers the preference, conditional request, and feared consequence into one articulated petition after the coercive threat of 12:32. The compact morphology keeps Joseph recoverable as speaker while the first overt addressee becomes {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}), shifting the scene from public pressure to divine address. The same speech root that framed Joseph's refusal and counter-accusation earlier (12:23; 12:26) now opens prayer, and the utterance will close by refusing the ignorance category echoed in 12:89 and 2:67.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) makes the prayer personal before the preference is stated. The construct suffix binds Lordship to Joseph as speaker, and the later {{ar:تَصْرِفْ}} ({{tr:taṣrif}}) shows why that title matters: the addressed Lord is the one asked to redirect the scheme. Variant case pressure survives as a syntactic contrast, but the local standard wording keeps the word primarily as vocative address. Surah 12 can use lordship language for an earthly master (12:23) and divine teaching (12:37); here the authority is redirected to God, and 12:34 turns the addressed Lord into the responding Lord.

words.gloss_range: the identifiable threatened prison, revalued as the preferred alternative in the comparison
words.root_gloss_range: confinement, enclosure, imprisonment, and related bounded-place imagery; here the concrete prison named as a chosen alternative
words.prose: {{ar:السِّجْنُ}} ({{tr:al-sijnu}}) takes the subject position in the comparison, so the threatened prison becomes the thing Joseph ranks as dearer. Its definiteness points back to the imprisonment threatened in 12:32, while the confinement root makes the choice physically bounded: enclosed prison is preferred over uncontained movement toward the women. Variant pressure toward an imprisonment-process reading survives as contrast, but the local form presents the prison as a definite concrete alternative. The same root then threads the Egyptian episode into prison companions and prison teaching (12:36; 12:39; 12:41; 12:42), so the oppressors' coercive prison threat, like Pharaoh's threat in 26:29, becomes the setting of Lord-centered speech.

words.prose: {{ar:أَحَبُّ}} ({{tr:aḥabbu}}) makes the comparison emotional as well as evaluative: prison is not merely better but more beloved to Joseph than what they call him toward. The elative grammar works with {{ar:إِلَيَّ}} ({{tr:ilayya}}) and {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) to build a ranked scale of desire, reversing the expected attraction of the scene. The rare comparative shape also recalls the family preference language of 12:8, but here the scale is morally inverted: belovedness is attached to prison rather than rivalry or temptation. Secondary lexical branches remain background only; the local force is comparative belovedness and moral preference.

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْبُ}} ({{tr:aṣbu}}) is the first feared result if aversion fails. Grammatically it is a jussive apodosis with no direct object, completed by the direction {{ar:إِلَيْهِنَّ}} ({{tr:ilayhinna}}); semantically it makes yielding feel like pouring toward them, a loss of containment opposite the requested turning-away. The variant {{ar:أَصَبُّ}} ({{tr:aṣabbu}}) would shift toward intensified comparative characterization, but the local form keeps the outcome conditional and verbal. Its uncommon pouring-root use appears at the crisis point, pairing temptation with collapse risk before the second consequence names classification.

words.prose: {{ar:الْجَاهِلِينَ}} ({{tr:al-jāhilīn}}) is the ayah's final landing. The definite active participle plural names a recognized class of people characterized by ignorance, so Joseph fears not only a bad act but being counted among a moral-epistemic type. The root pressure is behavioral as well as cognitive: ignorance is action without rightly guided knowledge. Same-surah and cross-surah echoes sharpen the closure: Joseph later names his brothers' past state with the same root (12:89), and prophetic speech elsewhere refuses being among the ignorant (2:67; 11:46).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative construction around prison, what they call him toward, divine turning, his inclination, and becoming one of the ignorant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sentence ranks two constraints: prison fixes the body within a boundary, while verbal invitation pulls the heart. Turning away the plot interrupts call to inclination to impulsive ignorance, so the preferred prison is a chosen outer limit against inner capture.

activation_trace.role: Literal confinement supplies the bounded bodily condition that is deliberately preferred.
Heart-held preference turns the comparison into an active ordering of rival attachments.
A spoken call that bends its addressee supplies the incoming pull in the mechanism.
Turning something away from its face supplies the requested interruption of that pull.
The heart's youthful tilt supplies the vulnerable inward motion that prison is meant to block.
Lightness of restraint and disturbed temperament make ignorance the behavioral endpoint of the tilt.

changed_reading.before: Prison is simply the less unpleasant of two outcomes.
changed_reading.after: He chooses controllable bodily confinement as a boundary against a less controllable capture of heart and conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The spoken address to his Lord and the conditional sequence 'unless You turn ... I incline ... and become.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A settled moral preference coexists with an explicit forecast of personal failure. By making ignorance a possible future state and redirection an act requested from his Lord, the speaker denies that insight or resolve makes him self-sufficient.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech externalizes a private risk assessment as a petition.
Sustaining, repairing lordship supplies the agency asked to complete what resolve cannot secure alone.
Transfer from one state or direction supplies the needed change in the causal course.
Coming to be in time makes ignorance a contingent transition rather than a fixed identity.
Loss of knowledge names the state into which unprotected resolve could pass.

changed_reading.after: It displays lucid self-knowledge: correct judgment is present, but its preservation still requires divine redirection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed directional constructions 'turn away from me' and 'incline toward them.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping of inclination activates pouring and downhill flow. On this reading the plot establishes a gradient, divine turning changes the channel, and without it the self spills toward the women and enters the agitation of ignorance; prison supplies a fixed counter-state.

activation_trace.role: Changing a thing from course to course supplies the channel-switching operation.
Pouring from above gives the inward inclination a fluid directional image.
A descending channel supplies the gradient along which unredirected desire would move.
Motion and agitation after stillness supply the terminal disorder of the cascade.
A severity that fixes its subject supplies the stable alternative to downhill movement.

changed_reading.before: Inclination is a single inward consent to temptation.
changed_reading.after: Inclination is a directional cascade whose course must be changed before it settles into conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The man previously exchanged at a deficient price now uses a comparative of love to value his own alternatives. Choosing prison over elite access reverses the surrounding economy: the person priced and used by others becomes the evaluator, and moral integrity outranks both utility and pleasure.

activation_trace.role: Exchange between buyer and seller supplies the prior scene in which others assign his value.
Sale value supplies the explicit external scale against which his later valuation reverses.
Diminution of due worth sharpens the contrast between being undervalued and choosing by a higher measure.
An intensified preference supplies his counter-valuation of the offered outcomes.

structural_cues: 12:20 places sale, deficient price, counted coins, and abstention in one valuation scene.
12:33 answers with a first-person comparative of preference rather than a price.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external pricing and later comparative preference; I infer assigned value -> reclaimed evaluative agency; alternatively the comparative may express only aversion, with no deliberate answer to the sale scene.

changed_reading.before: The comparison merely says how much he dislikes the invitation.
changed_reading.after: The person whom others priced now reclaims valuation, ranking integrity above the social goods offered to him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The alternative to prison was already an enclosure: solicitation occurred in a house whose doors were forcibly secured. The contrast is therefore not open freedom versus confinement but a private enclosure designed for capture versus a named, chosen enclosure that blocks participation.

activation_trace.role: Persistent solicitation supplies the action for which the closed space was arranged.
Coercive tightening and closure supply the first enclosure's controlling function.
The doorway as access point makes its closure a deliberate control of entry and exit.
Prison supplies the second enclosure, whose purpose is inverted from capture to refusal.

structural_cues: 12:23 combines a private house, emphatically closed doors, and direct solicitation.
12:33 compares prison with the destination of that solicitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two bounded spaces and opposed purposes; I infer shared enclosure -> contrast of who controls the boundary; alternatively prison may function only as a threatened consequence, not as a spatial foil to the house.

changed_reading.before: He prefers confinement to an available freedom.
changed_reading.after: He chooses between enclosures, preferring the boundary that prevents moral capture to the sealed room that enables it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context gives him discerning judgment and knowledge, then makes truth legible through testimony and visible signs, yet records a decision to imprison after those signs were seen. Becoming one of the ignorant can therefore mean forfeiting known truth in action and joining a social order that behaves against disclosure, not merely lacking information.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure supplies the cognitive possession that could be forfeited in conduct.
Accurate wisdom supplies the mature judgment opposed to becoming ignorant.
Testimony that states what is known supplies an articulated route from evidence to truth.
What becomes manifest supplies the disclosure preceding the later decision.
Visible signs supply the evidence that the decision-makers nevertheless override.
Conduct contrary to right restraint makes ignorance an enacted disorder despite available knowledge.

structural_cues: 12:26-28 repeatedly tests truth and falsehood against the torn shirt.
12:35 explicitly places the imprisonment decision after the signs were seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gifted judgment, disclosed evidence, and action after seeing signs; I infer knowing truth yet acting against it -> enacted and institutional ignorance; alternatively the speaker may intend only his own youthful folly, without indicting the later institution.

changed_reading.before: The ignorant are simply people who do not know that the invited act is wrong.
changed_reading.after: Ignorance is the active forfeiture of disclosed judgment, a class he fears joining even as the surrounding institution models it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prison first enters as a proposed penalty and later as leverage attached to an order and humiliation. By naming that same outcome preferable, the speaker seizes the coercer's sanction and turns it into a protective boundary; power can impose the location but cannot preserve its intended meaning.

activation_trace.role: Confinement first appears as the punitive destination assigned by the accuser.
An obligating demand supplies the coercive condition attached to the prison threat.
Repeated confinement supplies the threatened consequence he will deliberately revalue.
Humiliation supplies the social meaning the threat is intended to impose.
Intensified preference reverses the sanction's value without denying its physical cost.

structural_cues: 12:25 introduces prison as punishment for an accusation.
12:32 makes compliance the alternative to prison and abasement.
12:33 immediately adopts prison as the preferred outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanction, command, humiliation, and immediate preference; I infer imposed penalty -> appropriated refuge; alternatively he may select only the lesser evil without positively transforming the sanction's meaning.

changed_reading.before: He passively accepts the punishment because the other option is worse.
changed_reading.after: He deprives coercion of its intended leverage by converting its threatened prison into his chosen protective boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context has just named a love that penetrates the heart, while the focus uses the same love field to rank prison. His comparative is not affectless calculation: it counters engulfing passion with a deliberately reordered attachment, making prison the object of a protective counter-love.

activation_trace.role: Love reaching the heart's covering supplies the context's image of penetrating passion.
The heart's innermost locus supplies the depth attributed to the woman's attachment.
Heart-held preference lets the speaker answer passion by deliberately reordering what is loved.

structural_cues: 12:30 names penetrating love immediately before the staged collective encounter.
12:33 reuses the love root in a comparative whose object is prison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two nearby uses of the love field with opposed objects; I infer invasive passion -> protective counter-attachment; alternatively 'more beloved' may be an idiom of preference with little affective force.

changed_reading.before: Prison is merely judged less harmful.
changed_reading.after: Prison becomes a counter-object of love, chosen to reorder rather than merely suppress desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gossip is converted into a prepared group spectacle: women are summoned, implements are readied, sight produces bodily cutting, and the scene culminates in an obligating demand. The focus plurals therefore name a coordinated pressure field, not a generic set of temptresses or one private invitation.

activation_trace.role: The women as a group supply the social body later gathered into the pressure mechanism.
Dispatch and setting in motion turn circulating speech into an organized encounter.
Something present and prepared supplies the scene's deliberate staging.
Actual severing supplies bodily evidence that the spectacle can override ordinary control.
An obligating request turns attraction into explicit compliance pressure.
The call's capacity to incline its hearer anchors the staged social mechanism in the focus wording.
Strategic contrivance names the collective scene as designed pressure rather than spontaneous attraction.

structural_cues: 12:30-31 moves from reported group speech to invitation, preparation, display, and synchronized reaction.
12:33 repeats plural objects in the call, the inclination, and the plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged sequence and repeated plurals; I infer spectacle -> social amplification -> coercive chorus; alternatively some women may remain only witnesses, so collective pressure need not imply equal conspiratorial intent.

changed_reading.before: He resists one woman's proposition while other women are incidental.
changed_reading.after: He asks protection from a manufactured social field in which spectacle, imitation, command, and threat make the invitation collective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine turning away appears before the focus, self-protective holding fast appears immediately before it, and an answering turn follows it. Protection is therefore recurrent cooperation rather than a permanent possession: prior rescue and present resolve do not cancel the need for renewed redirection.

activation_trace.role: A prior turning away supplies an already experienced pattern of protection.
Self-holding that prevents and preserves supplies the human act within the protective sequence.
The renewed request for turning shows that successful resistance is not treated as stored immunity.
A reply to speech supplies the causal bridge from petition to response.
The completed turning supplies the answered operation requested in the focus.

structural_cues: 12:24, 12:33, and 12:34 repeat the same redirection root around the trial.
12:32 places active self-restraint between the earlier turning and the prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior redirection, self-restraint, petition, and answer; I infer repeated protection + effort -> non-autonomous cooperation; alternatively the repetitions may narrate one continuous rescue without a broader claim about recurrent dependence.

changed_reading.before: He asks for a new intervention because his own resistance has failed.
changed_reading.after: He renews a protection already experienced while still exerting restraint, treating moral safety as repeated cooperation rather than personal possession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a non-dominant split mapping recasts a verbal invitation as violent pushing. It remains anchored in the focus call and is strengthened by the explicit command and humiliation threat in 12:32; downstream prose should present it as a pressure image, not as a replacement gloss for the surface verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb for what they call him toward, followed by the feared inclination.

activation_trace.role: A forceful shove supplies the latent coercive underside of the ostensibly verbal call.
Obligating demand supplies visible contextual pressure that makes the shove image live.
Threatened abasement supplies the social force behind the demand.

changed_reading.before: They offer an invitation that he remains free simply to decline.
changed_reading.after: Their call functions like a shove: speech, rank, threat, and shame apply directional force while preserving the grammar of invitation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the alternate mapped root for inclination contributes both pouring and placement in fetters. It remains anchored by the opposed directionals, the prison noun, and the conditional fall toward them; downstream prose should retain it only as a material analogy for loss of agency, not as lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence from requested redirection to inclination toward them, set against prison.

activation_trace.role: Pouring supplies the image of agency spilling along an unblocked course.
The heart pouring itself into desire makes the directional flow specifically affective.
Placement in a fetter supplies an alternate inner captivity reached by that flow.
Literal prison supplies the visible captivity preferred over the less visible fetter of desire.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts imprisonment with attraction.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts two captivities: chosen outer confinement and an unredirected flow that pours the heart into its own fetter.

strongest_changes: Prison becomes a chosen boundary that inverts both the coercively closed room and the punitive threat.
Becoming ignorant becomes forfeiture of disclosed judgment in action, not merely absence of information.
The plural plot becomes a staged social pressure field, while protection emerges as repeated cooperation rather than stored immunity.
summary.what_was_special: The comparative love term reclaims valuation and answers penetrating passion with counter-love; split mappings also preserve the stranger but anchored images of invitation as a shove and inclination as pouring into an inner fetter.
remaining_uncertainties: The love comparative may be rhetorical preference rather than a positive counter-attachment.
The non-dominant mapped branches are heuristic material images and must not replace the surface lexemes.
The retrospective evidence of 12:35 may characterize the surrounding institution more strongly than the speaker's immediate use of 'ignorant' in 12:33.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Confinement is preferred as a boundary against a calling.** س ج ن B001, ح ب ب B003 (formula of approval/utmost desire), and د ع و B001 (calling to draw near) produce a paradoxical preference. I infer that physical restriction can preserve moral agency when social invitation is coercive. Prison reads as chosen lesser enclosure.
2. **Diversion prevents inclination from becoming rashness.** ص ر ف B001, ك ي د B002, ص ب و B002 (heart-inclination/youthful longing), and ج ه ل B002 (rash unsettled folly) form a causal chain explicitly acknowledged as vulnerability. The ayah preserves attraction and refusal together: protection redirects inclination rather than denying its possibility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:34 answered the requested diversion, yet 12:35 still sent Yusuf to prison; protection changed the prison’s function rather than simply preventing it.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Inclination as a directional force requiring diversion.** `ص ب و:B002` is “heart-inclination and youthful longing”; dormant `ص ب و:B004` is physical tilting and inversion. The syntax sets two directions—prison as preferred and the women as a possible inclination—then makes divine *ṣarf* the condition preventing the latter; 12:34 echoes the exact turning language. The packet supplies the vectors; I infer that repeated coercion can tilt choice unless another force redirects it. *Aṣbu ilayhinna* reads as acknowledged susceptibility under pressure, which makes refuge and refusal causally intelligible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:90 names guardedness and patience together as the condition under which favor arrives, showing that the directional pull anticipated here was managed over time rather than settled by a single prayer.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تقول باطلا، وتقول عليه أي كذب عليه، وقولتني أو أقولتني ما لم أقل.
يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.
يدخل فيه القول بمعنى الاعتقاد، نحو فلان يقول بقول أبي حنيفة.
يدخل فيه القول للدلالة على الشيء، مثل امتلأ الحوض وقال قطني.
يدخل فيه فلان يقول بكذا إذا كان معناه العناية الصادقة بالشيء.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sevgiyi nefretin karşıtı olarak verir, onu iyi görülen şeye yönelen güçlü istekle açıklar ve yeğleme kullanımını ayrıca belirtir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu duygusal ve seçimsel alanı doğru biçimde temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kök anlamını verir; taneye, övgü kalıbına veya başka özel söz öbeklerine ait anlamlar tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi veya iyi görülen bir şeyi gönülden isteme ve ona olumlu bağlanma duygusudur; nefretin karşıtıdır. Bu yönelim, bir şeyi başka bir şeye yeğleme biçiminde seçime de dönüşebilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye veya şeye yönelen sevgi ve olumlu bağlılık; nefretin karşıtı.
İyi olduğu görülen veya sanılan şeyi güçlü biçimde isteme.
Sevilen veya istenen bir şeyi başka bir seçeneğe üstün tutma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kayıt sevgiyi nefretin karşıtı ve iyi görülene yönelen güçlü istek olarak kurar; aynı yönelimin seçimde yeğleme anlamı kazandığını da belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal bağlılık çekirdeği ile seçimde üstün tutma uzantısını birlikte karşılayan kısa ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Sevgi duygusunu, iyi görülene yönelişi ve yeğleme uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye veya şeye duyulan olumlu bağlılığın öne çıktığı genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Duygusal bağlılık ve nefretin karşıtı olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi başka bir şeye bilinçli olarak yeğleme uzantısını açıkça vermez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyi görülen şeye yönelen güçlü sevgi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak alanı kişiye veya şeye duyulan olumlu bağlılık ve sevgidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Duygusal çekirdekte büyük ölçüde örtüşürler; odak dal seçimsel yeğlemeye uzanırken komşu dal karşılıklı yakınlık ve ilişki boyutunu daha geniş tuttuğu için sınırları tam değildir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحب والمحبة ونقيض البغض، والتحبيب، والمحبوب، والاستحباب بمعنى الإيثار، والمودة المتبادلة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlam değil, övgü bildiren kalıbı, bir işi yapmaya yönelik en güçlü isteği ve hoş bir kabul cevabını birlikte verir. Dal ancak bu üç kullanımın ayrı kalıplar olduğu açıkça belirtilirse korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal iki söz öbeği ile bir kalıplaşmış cevap birimini içerir; bunların işlevleri yalın kökün genel anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarla bir kişiyi ya da şeyi övme, bir eylemi en güçlü istek olarak sunma veya öneriyi hoşnutlukla kabul etme işlevidir. Bu işlevler genel sevgi anlamı değil, kalıba bağlı söylem kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Belirli söz kalıplarıyla övgü, güçlü istek veya hoşnut kabul bildirme.
Bir kişi veya şeyi öven ve iyi bulduğunu bildiren kalıp.
Bir işi yapmayı isteğin son noktası olarak sunan ya da öneriyi memnuniyetle kabul eden kalıp.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kayıt, övgü kalıbını, bir eyleme yönelik en yüksek istek bildirimini ve olumlu kabul cevabını aynı kalıplaşmış kullanım alanında toplar.

concept_gloss.text: övgü, güçlü istek ve kabul bildiren kalıplar

error_profile.preserves: Övgüyü, isteğin en yüksek derecesini ve olumlu kabul işlevini korur.

error_profile.loses: En güçlü istek bildirimini ve memnuniyetle kabul cevabını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Övgü işlevinde yaklaşırlar, fakat odak dal belirli bir yapıyla sınırlıdır ve ayrıca istek ile kabul kalıplarını içerir; komşu dalın övgü yapısı bu ek işlevleri taşımaz.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه حبذا، وحبابك أن تفعل، ونعم وحبة وكرامة، وما جاء بصيغة مدح أو بلوغ الغاية في المحبة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kalbin içindeki kara bölümü, çekirdeği ya da meyvesi olarak adlandırılan kısmı ve bunun taneye biçimce benzetilmesini açıkça verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu anatomik ve benzetmeli sınırı doğru korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تصريف الرياح والسيول والخيول والأمور والآيات والكلام والكلمة، أي نقلها أو إجراؤها من وجه إلى وجه ومن حال إلى حال.

branches.branch_image_ar: صرف يقابل العدل في القبول أو الدفع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الصرف في عبارة لا يقبل منه صرف ولا عدل، وما فسر بالتوبة أو النافلة أو الحيلة، وكذلك صرفا بمعنى وسيلة دفع أو تحويل في مقابلة النصر.
يدخل فيه بيع الذهب بالفضة، وصرف الدراهم بالدنانير، وفضل الدرهم على الدرهم في القيمة أو جودة الفضة، واسم الصيرفي والصراف.
يدخل فيه صرف الحديث أو الكلام بمعنى تزيينه والزيادة فيه حتى تميل الأسماع أو القلوب إليه، وفضل بعض الكلام على بعض.
يدخل فيه حدث الدهر ونوائبه وصروفه، وما يتقلب بالناس من أمور الزمان، والصرفان إذا أريد بهما الليل والنهار.
يدخل فيه الصرفة اسما لمنزل أو كوكب، وتسميتها بانصراف البرد أو إقبال الحر، وقولهم ناب الدهر.
يدخل فيه الصرفة خرزة أو أخذ يزعم به صرف قلب الرجل عما يريد.
يدخل فيه الصراف أو الصرافة للشاء والبقر والكلاب والسباع إذا اشتهت الفحل، وناقة أو كلبة أو عنز صارف.
يدخل فيه صريف ناب البعير، وصريف البكرة، وصريف الباب، وما أشبهه من صوت يرده الاحتكاك أو الدوران.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal çıplak bir yer ve arazi anlamıdır; başka dallardaki dökme eylemi ya da özel kalıplar tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Arazinin aşağı doğru eğilen bölümü ya da yolun veya ırmağın suyu ve yolcuyu aşağıya yönelten inişli kesimidir.

facets.statement: Arazi yüzeyinde aşağı doğru inen belirgin bir eğim bulunur.
Bu iniş, bir yolun ya da ırmağın aşağı yönlü kesimi ve akış yatağı olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, aşağı doğru eğilen araziyi ve yol veya ırmak üzerindeki inişli kesimi aynı yer biçimi altında toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem arazi eğimini hem de yol veya su yatağındaki aşağı yönü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Genel arazi biçiminin aşağı doğru eğildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Arazideki aşağı yönlü eğimi açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.text: aşağı inen yol veya su yatağı

error_profile.preserves: Yol ve su yatağındaki iniş yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: inişli yer; aşağı eğimli yol veya ırmak kesimi

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıcı bir yer veya yol biçimidir; komşu dal ise nesneyi eğme ve aşağı yöneltme eylemlerine de uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın çekirdeği iki dağ arasındaki açıklık, geçit veya dallanan vadidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi arazi içinde yol veya su geçişi sağlayabilen yer biçimleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İniş yönü odak dal için kurucudur; iki yükselti arasındaki açıklık ise komşu dal için kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sevgiyle birine yönelmeyi, özlemin inceliğini ve yakıcılığını, ayrıca bu duygunun kişiyi yenmesini anlatır. Dal çerçevesi duygu, yöneliş ve bu duyguyu taşıyan kişi ayrımını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygunun adı, bu duyguyu taşıyan kişi ve birine sevgiyle yönelme yapısı ayrı tutulur; hiçbiri tek başına bütün dala eşitlenmez.

Duygu kişiye baskın gelir ve gönlünü sevdiğine doğru yöneltir.
Bu güçlü sevgi ve özlemi taşıyan erkek veya kadın da ayrıca nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sevgiyle yöneliş, ince ve yakıcı özlem ve bu duygunun kişiye baskın gelmesi üzerinde birleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hafiflik ve dinginlik karşıtlığını, özdenetim eksikliğini, yapılması gerekene aykırı davranmayı ve bir kişiyi kışkırtarak olağan huyundan çıkarmayı birlikte verir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu davranış ve tutum alanını doğru yansıtır.

concept_map.definition: Özdenetim ve ağırbaşlılığın yerini hafif, taşkın bir tutumun alması ve kişinin yapılması gerekene aykırı davranmasıdır. Belirli yapılarda bir etkenin kişiyi kışkırtıp olağan huyundan çıkararak öfkelendirmesini de anlatır.

facets.statement: Özdenetimin ve ağırbaşlılığın yerini hafif, taşkın ve dengesiz bir tutum alır.
Kişi yapılması gereken doğru biçime aykırı ve ölçüsüz davranır.
Bir etken kişiyi küçümseyerek veya kışkırtarak olağan huyundan çıkarıp öfkelendirebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi tutumdaki hafiflik ile doğru davranıştan sapmayı ortak çekirdekte buluşturur ve kışkırtıcı neden yapısını bu çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısı olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yalın tutum ve davranış çekirdeğini karşılar; kışkırtma anlamı ayrıca bağlamsal olarak belirtilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin ağırbaşlılığını yitirerek ölçüsüz ve yapılması gerekene aykırı davrandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal özdenetimin savrulmasına odaklanan dar bir anlatımdır; odak dal davranışın yanlış biçimini ve dışarıdan kışkırtmayı da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ağırbaşlılığın ve doğru davranışın karşıtı olan insani tutumu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da dinginlikten çıkan, denetimsiz ve atak bir durum bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal davranış ölçüsünden çok hareketli huzursuzluğu ve sıçramayı kapsar; odak dal özdenetim ve yapılması gereken davranışla ilgilidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi közleri hareket ettiren bir çubuğu, rüzgârın dalı sallayıp titreştirmesini ve tencerenin kaynayıp durulmamasını birlikte verir. Bunların tümünde önceki bir durgunluk evresi açıkça belirtilmediğinden dal, hareket ettirme ve durulmadan çalkalanma çevresinde yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Közleri hareket ettiren araç adı ile rüzgâr ve tencereyi konu alan yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlardan genel bir yalın anlam türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Dal, bir şeyi hareket ettirme ile bir şeyin durulmadan çalkalanması çevresinde toplanır; közleri karıştıran çubuğun adıyla, rüzgârın dalı salladığı ve tencerenin kaynayıp durulmadığı özel kullanımları birbirinden ayırır.

facets.statement: Ortak anlam alanı bir şeyi harekete geçirmek veya bir şeyin durulmadan hareketlenip çalkalanmasıdır.
Közleri hareket ettirip karıştırmak için kullanılan çubuk bu hareket alanından ad alır.
Belirli bir yapıda rüzgâr dalı hareket ettirir ve dal titreşip sallanır.
Başka bir yapıda tencerenin içi kaynar ve durulmadan hareketini sürdürür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi araç, dış etkiyle hareket ve kendiliğinden kaynayıp durulmama kullanımlarını ortak bir hareket alanında birleştirir, ancak bunları tek bir kullanım türüne indirgemez.
